title: Safety Evaluation of DeepSeek Models in Chinese Contexts
findings: The paper found that DeepSeek models performed poorly on safety tasks related to religion. In a multiple-choice task to identify religious extremism, both DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V3 failed, selecting an answer that was the opposite of extremist behavior. In refusal-to-answer tasks, DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V3 had very low refusal rates for prompts involving 'religious discrimination' (9.1% and 4.5% respectively), indicating a deficiency in handling such sensitive topics.
